sources.publisher: Salesforce AI Research; card identifies Stephen Merity at Salesforce as contact.
sources.citation: Merity, Xiong, Bradbury and Socher, Pointer Sentinel Mixture Models, 2016, arXiv1609.07843.
sources.license_prose: Pinned README Licensing Information links CC BY-SA4.0; this conflicts with its YAML metadata.
sources.license_interpretation: Both publisher statements are preserved. No definitive version resolution is asserted.
sources.transform: Select eligible raw row; retain full original row and nearest top-level Wikipedia article title; prompt is first160 whitespace words joined with spaces.
sources.attribution: Per-item article title, Wikipedia article URL and history URL in selected_source_records.json, plus exact publisher card snapshot. Original historical Wikipedia revision/author list is not provided by this dataset view.
sources.sample_scope: 8 chunks from7 Wikipedia articles; not8 independent documents.
sources.legacy_homepage_check: Card's blog.einstein.ai homepage was unavailable through browser; the publisher HF repo remains pinned.

sources.publisher: Ai2. Official https://allenai.org/data/arc redirects to this publisher HF repository.
sources.citation: Clark et al., Think you have Solved Question Answering? Try ARC, the AI2 Reasoning Challenge, 2018, arXiv1803.05457.
sources.license_prose: Licensing Information body is a More Information Needed placeholder; the YAML license is recorded as publisher-stated.
sources.transform: Full stem and choices in publisher order; normalized only leading/trailing whitespace plus fixed label punctuation/newlines.
sources.answers: Correct label/index/text retained only in answers/arc_answers.json. Prompts contain all choices but no appended correct label or answer cue.
sources.sample_scope: 8 predeclared-length-eligible validation questions; not a benchmark accuracy estimate.

interpretation: Dataset revisions and model checkpoint revisions are separate fields in the frozen protocol.
New workload means unused by the current placement fit/numeric experiments; model-pretraining contamination has not been ruled out.
No new model, quantization design, weight calibration or placement fit.
Free generation16/32tokens cannot be reported as ARC accuracy. Teacher forcing and numerical equivalence need separate inference protocols.
The acquisition protocol froze item-kind/order/rules, not unknown source identities before download; identities are deterministically resolved by its hash ranking.
